messages:
Alex: Heads up — we got a sustained token/sec drop (~25%) on the continuous-batcher fleet after today's canary (~09:12 UTC). prod metrics + perf-bot CI perf test both show the regression.

Maya: saw the alert, looking at per-gpu token/sec. Looks like some hosts are 30% lower while others unchanged. KV hitrate also dipped ~8%.

Chen: any obvious rollout that touched kernel selection or prefetch heuristics?

Alex: two PRs merged in the window: r/infra/8342 (kernel selection heuristic: prefer memcpy-path for <512 seq to reduce kernel switching) and r/runtime/8399 (continuous-batcher: enqueue threshold tweak). both merged ~09:05.

Sam: perf-bot posted CI regression for continuous-batcher microbench earlier: https://ci.internal/reports/CTB-regression-32001 (summary: -22% tokens/sec on small-seq workloads).

perf-bot: automated-check: 3200123456 - CTB throughput drop detected. Confidence: high. Suggested cause: kernel-selection change r/infra/8342.

Maya: I repro locally on a canary image with the kernel change. If I force kernel affinity to previous selector, throughput returns to baseline.

Chen: interesting — maybe memcpy-path is winning but has worse scheduling/coalescing behavior under continuous batching. Could be extra memcopies causing queueing delay.

Alex: logs from canary host (excerpt):
```
[09:13:02] ctb_scheduler: enqueue_delay_ms p95=48 (baseline 15)
[09:13:02] kernel_selector: chosen=memcpy_fast variant=2
[09:13:02] kv_cache: hitrate=0.78 (baseline 0.86)
[09:13:02] tokenproc: tokens/sec=420k (baseline 560k)
```

Sam: also saw increased small-batch churn in traces — many 1-4 token batches and higher wake frequency. that interacts poorly with memcpy path that expects contiguous allocation.

Maya: I'm running a bisect between the two PRs and the last good revision. current plan: isolate kernel selector change first, then the enqueue threshold.

Alex: FYI running an internal perf harness now: `perf-run --suite ctb_throughput --seed small-seq --runs 10` on canary image with r/infra/8342 reverted locally. will post numbers in 10m.

Chen: quick hypothesis: memcpy-path increases per-inference memcpy count which increases GPU DMA contention and raises latency variance -> CTB scheduling wakes more frequently -> smaller batches -> token/sec drop. also KV miss because prefetch timing changed.

perf-bot: bisect job queued: https://ci.internal/bisect/3200123456. candidate commits: 9a7f4a (pre-merge good), d4c3b21 (r/infra/8342), f1e2d33 (r/runtime/8399). expected runtime ~45m.

Alex: results from local harness with kernel-selector reverted: tokens/sec = 560k (baseline). with only enqueue-threshold revert: tokens/sec = 510k (partial recovery). with both reverted = 565k.

Maya: bisect CI finished early: points to d4c3b21 (r/infra/8342) as the primary regression.

Sam: confirmed on two different instance types (g4dn-like and p4-like) — same pattern.

Chen: can we mitigate quickly without full revert? maybe force kernel variant fallback for CTB workloads only (config flag) while we fix memcpy implementation.

Alex: good idea. we can gate selector with a runtime flag: `--kernel-selector=legacy` for CTB route. I'll draft a hotfix PR to flip selector for the CTB route only.

Maya: prefer revert of r/infra/8342 as it touches core selection logic and is risky. hotfix is less risky if we can push fast.

Sam: deployment plan: push config flag change to canary subset (10% traffic) and measure tokens/sec + kv hit. if stable, roll to 50% then 100%. if not, revert r/infra/8342 across fleet.

infra-bot: deploy started: cluster=ctb-canary-1, image=sha:f1e2d33-hotfix, targets=10%

Alex: can everyone watch the dashboards (CTB tokens/sec, enqueue_delay_ms, kv_cache_hitrate) for next 20m? pull alerts if regression persists.

Maya: can confirm canary with hotfix shows tokens/sec back to ~560k and enqueue p95 down to 18ms. KV hitrate back to 0.85. :thumbsup:

Chen: great, still want a follow-up to address root cause in memcpy path. I'll open an investigation ticket (INV-ctb-kernel-memcopy-320012) with profiling data and a reproducer.

Sam: I'll keep the bisect artifacts and perf runs attached to the incident. Sam -> creating revert PR in case hotfix fails: r/infra/revert-8342.

Alex: decision: hold main rollout for r/infra/8342 and r/runtime/8399 until root cause fixed. hotfix gate in place for CTB path. Documented in the rollout tracker: https://eng.internal/rollouts/3200123456.

Maya: done — added follow-up tasks: profiling, memory access tracing, KV prefetch timing.

perf-bot: incident closed (mitigated) at 3200123550. tag=ctb-throughput-regression, action=hotfix-flagged, revert-pr=r/infra/revert-8342 (draft).
